name: MonarchMarketingSection
title: Marketing sections
summary: The bands of a welcome or product tour screen: MonarchMarketingSection with its header, MonarchFeatureGrid, MonarchProductFrame, MonarchStatStrip, MonarchFaq and MonarchCtaBand.
whenToUse: Between the hero and the footer of a signed-out screen: a section for each band, a feature grid for capabilities, a product frame for illustrations, a stat strip for a few true figures, an FAQ for questions and one closing call to action.
whenNotToUse: On signed-in screens, use MonarchCard, MonarchStatCard and the settings components.
api: @Composable fun MonarchMarketingSection(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, eyebrow: String? = null, description: String? = null, align: MonarchMarketingAlign = MonarchMarketingAlign.Start, tone: MonarchMarketingSectionTone = MonarchMarketingSectionTone.Default, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)
@Composable fun MonarchFeatureGrid(items: List<MonarchFeatureGridItem>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, columns: Int = 2)
@Composable fun MonarchProductFrame(label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, title: String? = null, content: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit)
@Composable fun MonarchStatStrip(items: List<MonarchStatStripItem>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier)
@Composable fun MonarchFaq(items: List<MonarchFaqItem>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier)
@Composable fun MonarchCtaBand(title: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, actions: (@Composable FlowRowScope.() -> Unit)? = null)
class MonarchFeatureGridItem(title: String, description: String? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null)

appearance: Eyebrows use the strong accent, titles the default text, descriptions the muted colour. Feature cards are MonarchCard; the product frame has the surface with the default border; the call to action band the subtle accent with the accent border; stats a large value over a muted label. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web exports MarketingSection and MarketingSectionHeader separately; on Android the header is part of MonarchMarketingSection (title, eyebrow, description, align). The web FAQ uses disclosure elements; MonarchFaq is MonarchAccordion. The product frame's browser chrome is three dots and an address pill. Spacing variants of the web (spacing="sm") are not offered: the screen's own padding decides.
accessibility: Section titles, feature titles, FAQ questions and the call to action title are headings or buttons, so TalkBack users can move by heading.
Each feature card and each stat is one element read together.
The product frame is read as its label only; the illustration inside is not read.
FAQ questions are buttons that read their expanded or collapsed state.
edgeCases: The feature grid drops to one column on a narrow screen or at large font sizes.
An FAQ answer is not read until its question is expanded.
